Subject: Q4 upside consolidation — prepping CS checkpoint with HelixHealth

Team —

Quick note ahead of next week's checkpoint with HelixHealth (Maria Lopez). Finance ran a light sweep of our Q4 numbers and flagged some upside we're carrying as "best-case" that needs stage confirmation. I want to lock a clean commit row for forecasting by Friday so ops can close the quarter.

Ask: can CS confirm the maturity of the following expansion signals by 12/17?
- Platform pilot expanded to 12 internal teams (proofs logged) — confirm adoption level and pilot owners
- Next-year seat estimate: 120 -> need CS validation for a conservative commit number
- Procurement readiness: procurement team has asked for an updated PSA and support SLA notes

I've attached an "HLX_Q4_upside_summary_v2.xlsx" that crosswalks opportunity lines to product signals (sheets: adoption, legal_timeline). Marcus: can you review the seat math/usage assumptions? Monica: can you lead the CS ask to Maria and her procurement contact? Ben: if there are any pricing lock concerns, flag them and I'll escalate.

If we don't get confirmations by 12/17 we should demote some lines to upside so Finance can close. This is time-sensitive for revenue recognition planning.

Thanks —
Hannah

Thanks Hannah — looping in Maria and procurement thread. Maria, quick context: we're reconciling our forecast and need a short confirmation on adoption/seat counts to finalize the commit row. Can you confirm the pilot adoption (number of active pilot users and owners) and whether procurement needs anything else beyond the PSA draft we shared? Marcus and I will join a 20-min call if helpful.

Maria — next steps suggested:
1) Reply with confirmed pilot owners + active user count (or point to the internal tracker)
2) Confirm whether the PSA draft is sufficient for initial procurement review or if legal needs changes
3) If possible, provide a conservative seat-count that procurement would commit to for initial purchase (we can always stage additional seats)

We can be flexible on pricing until the PSA is finalized; Ben is on copy for any quick pricing guardrails. Proposed slot for a brief call if you prefer: 12/16 10:00am PT.

Thanks —
Monica

Hi Monica / Hannah / Marcus —

Thanks for the clear email. Quick responses below:

1) Pilot adoption: we have 9 active pilot owners (list attached) and about ~85 internal users actively testing workflows. I can share the internal tracker; it's not public but I can export a sanitized CSV if helpful.
2) PSA: procurement reviewed the PSA draft and requested two small edits around data retention terms and an explicit clause on audit access. Legal is comfortable with those edits — procurement will send redlines today.
3) Conservative seat-count: our initial procurement ask will target 80 seats for the first production wave. We expect to expand to 120 over the next 6 months but cannot commit to that today.

We can join a 20-min alignment call on 12/16 at 10:00am PT. I've added procurement (procurement@helixhealth.com) to help speed the PSA redlines.
